not_decided_register.title: Dr. Ashok Kumar Sharma & Another v. State of U.P. & 4 Others
not_decided_register.point: Ultimate fate of the eviction litigation
not_decided_register.note: The Court declined to speculate on the outcome of the pending execution/recall proceedings, deciding only that at this stage the tenants are not authorised occupiers.

not_decided_register.title: Dr. Munni Lal v. State of U.P. & Others
not_decided_register.point: Correctness of the assessment on merits
not_decided_register.note: Left to the objection/final-assessment process to be decided by a speaking order.

not_decided_register.title: Dr. Santosh Kumar Awasthi v. State of U.P. & Others
not_decided_register.point: Merits of the assessment
not_decided_register.note: The Court expressly stated it had not adjudicated the petitioner's claim on merits; stay during the appeal was left to the appellate authority.

not_decided_register.title: Dr. Vinod Kumar Bassi v. The State of U.P. & Anr.
not_decided_register.point: Everything on merits
not_decided_register.note: Purely interlocutory — only notice and an interim stay; no question was decided.

not_decided_register.title: Gauri Shankar Gupta v. State of U.P. & 4 Others
not_decided_register.point: Whether theft/unauthorised use was in fact committed
not_decided_register.note: Left open; the respondents were given liberty to make a fresh assessment on the theft allegation after hearing the petitioner.

not_decided_register.title: Harihar Cold Storage v. P.V.V.N.L. & Another
not_decided_register.point: Minimum-guarantee charges for 20.11.2004-8.5.2005
not_decided_register.note: That period (during which s.126 proceedings were on foot) was the subject of a separate writ petition (No. 31333 of 2006) and was not addressed here.

not_decided_register.title: Haryana State Electricity Board v. M/s Hanuman Rice Mills, Dhanauri & Ors.
not_decided_register.point: Correctness of Isha Marbles
not_decided_register.note: The Court did not reconsider the correctness of Isha Marbles; it decided on the absence of any pleaded statutory rule/condition authorising the demand.

not_decided_register.title: Hazi Mohd. Yaseen v. P.V.V.N.L. & Another
not_decided_register.point: Merits of the theft assessment and the meter-seal-tampering inference
not_decided_register.note: The Court did not decide the merits (or whether tampered cubicle seals per Clause 8.1(b)(i) ipso facto establish theft), leaving them to the fresh assessment/appeal; it declined to go into merits given the alternative remedy.

not_decided_register.title: Husna Bano v. State of U.P. & 9 Others
not_decided_register.point: Landlord-tenant / possession dispute
not_decided_register.note: Possession as tenant or otherwise was treated as a question of fact for the competent civil court; the connection does not bar the pending eviction/injunction suit.

not_decided_register.title: Jharkhand State Electricity Board & Others v. M/s Ramkrishna Forging Limited
not_decided_register.point: Validity of the proviso to Regulation 9.2.1
not_decided_register.note: The Court did not decide whether the proviso to Reg. 9.2.1 is discriminatory, arbitrary or against public policy (as the High Court had held); it decided on the initial-agreement construction.

not_decided_register.title: Kapil Gupta v. U.P. Power Corpn. Ltd. & Anr.
not_decided_register.point: Merits of the theft assessment
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; the petitioner was relegated to the statutory appeal under Section 127.

not_decided_register.title: Kisan Cold Storage & Ice Factory v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. & Ors. (Full Bench reference)
not_decided_register.point: Whether the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum is functionally independent of the Distribution Licensee
not_decided_register.note: The Court noted indicia suggesting the Forum's independence is 'illusory' (Licensee selects/removes members, funds the Forum) but expressly declined to decide the point, as it was not called upon to do so.

not_decided_register.title: Lala Ram Batham v. U.P. Power Corporation Nigam & Ors.
not_decided_register.point: Correctness of the disputed meter reading and the resulting arrears
not_decided_register.note: Expressly left undecided; relegated to the licensee's Clause 6.5 inquiry.

not_decided_register.title: M/S Birla Aircon v. District Magistrate, Meerut & Ors.
not_decided_register.point: Whether the sealed premises of M/s Birla Aircon fell within the premises sanctioned to M/s Beeco Electricals India
not_decided_register.note: Expressly left undetermined for want of material; remitted to the Collector for a fact-specific inquiry.

not_decided_register.title: M/S Dev Prayag Paper Mill (Pvt.) & Ors. v. State of U.P. & Ors. (batch of ~90 connected writ petitions)
not_decided_register.point: Whether the absence of regulations under Section 181 (as opposed to the Supply Code) renders the demand for security without authority of law
not_decided_register.note: Not examined in detail — raised only in oral submissions, not pleaded in any of the writ petitions, and in any event the Supply Code was held to cover the field that regulations would otherwise have addressed.

not_decided_register.title: M/S Hind Industries Limited v. State of U.P. & Ors.
not_decided_register.point: Correctness of the assessment order dated 17.8.2002 on merits, and the precise applicable interest rate/statute (1910/2003 Act)
not_decided_register.note: Left open, as there was no challenge to the assessment before any competent authority; the competent authority was directed to examine the rate of interest question, subject to a bank-rate floor.

not_decided_register.title: M/S Modern Rice Mill v. MVVNL & Anr.
not_decided_register.point: Whether the consumer in fact committed theft/unauthorised use of electrical energy
not_decided_register.note: Not decided on merits; quashed for procedural/legal defects, with liberty to the Assessing Officer to proceed afresh in accordance with law.

not_decided_register.title: M/S Mohit Paper Mills Ltd. & Anr. v. PVVNL & Ors.
not_decided_register.point: Whether the consumer in fact deliberately set fire to the metering cubicle
not_decided_register.note: Not conclusively decided in the consumer's favour or against; the assessment was quashed for want of established theft, without prejudice to the licensee taking such further action as permissible in law.

not_decided_register.title: M/S Om Ice Factory Thru' Its Partner Satyapal Singh v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. & Anr.
not_decided_register.point: Correctness of the theft assessment and the alleged Clause 4.30/4.31/6.8/8.0(5)/8.1 procedural flaws
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; the petitioner was relegated to the statutory appeal under Section 127.

not_decided_register.title: M/S Sartaj Rice Mill Thru' Its Partner Maqsood Ali v. Paschimanchal Vidhyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
not_decided_register.point: Applicability of the Section 56(2) two-year limitation bar to the pre-2003 overload assessments
not_decided_register.note: Raised by the petitioner but not squarely addressed by the Court, which decided the matter on the ground that the assessments had become final by the consumer's own acceptance/conduct.

not_decided_register.title: M/S Trikoot Iron & Steels Castings Ltd. v. State of U.P. & Ors.
not_decided_register.point: Correctness of the theft assessment on merits
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; remanded to the Appellate Authority for decision on merits within one month.

not_decided_register.title: M/S Urmila Oil Industries v. U.P. Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam & Ors.
not_decided_register.point: Whether the consumer in fact committed theft by bypassing the meter
not_decided_register.note: Not decided on merits; the assessment was set aside for procedural/reasoning defects, with liberty to reassess afresh.

not_decided_register.title: Madarsa Dargah Aaliya Islamiya Shareef Nagar & Anr. v. State of U.P. & 3 Others
not_decided_register.point: Correctness of the quantum demanded (Rs. 6,91,850)
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; relegated to the Clause 6.5B authority.

not_decided_register.title: Mohamdabad Cold Storage Private Ltd. (& Anr.) v. Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. & Ors.
not_decided_register.point: Correctness/quantum of the supplementary bill and whether the transformer defect in fact caused inaccurate billing
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; left to the Clause 5.6 testing process and, if invoked, the Electrical Inspector.

not_decided_register.title: Mohd Usman Ansari v. Chairman, Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Ltd. & 4 Others
not_decided_register.point: Correctness/quantum of the underlying electricity dues (Rs. 6,38,679/-)
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; to be determined by the final assessment after a hearing.

not_decided_register.title: Mohd. Ashfaq Khan @ Ashfaq Khan v. State of U.P. thru. Addl. Chief Secy., Energy Deptt., Lucknow & 3 Others
not_decided_register.point: Underlying title/possession dispute between the petitioner (occupant) and opposite party no. 4 (transferee-owner)
not_decided_register.note: Expressly left open for separate proceedings as may be permissible in law.

not_decided_register.title: Mrs Rajendra Kumar Sharma v. State of U.P. & 3 Others
not_decided_register.point: Whether the petitioner in fact committed theft of electricity
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; to be determined afresh by the assessing authority after due notice and hearing.

not_decided_register.title: Nadeem v. State of U.P. & 4 Others
not_decided_register.point: Correctness of the underlying s.126 final assessment (Rs. 99,842/-), separately pending before the Permanent Lok Adalat, Aligarh
not_decided_register.note: Not decided by the High Court; left to the Permanent Lok Adalat proceedings.

not_decided_register.title: Narendra Singh Panwar v. Pashchimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. & 2 Others
not_decided_register.point: Vires of Clause 4.3(f)(v) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 (Director liability provision) vis-a-vis s.2(15) Electricity Act, 2003's 'consumer' definition
not_decided_register.note: Not decided here for want of pleaded foundation; noted as separately pending in Izharul Hauque v. State of U.P. (Writ C No. 8370 of 2016), where an interim order dated 24.2.2016 had been passed.

not_decided_register.title: Narendra Singh Panwar v. Pashchimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. & 2 Others
not_decided_register.point: Extent/nature of the signatory Director's (Ashok Sharma's) personal-guarantee liability under his notarized undertaking
not_decided_register.note: Expressly left open, as that Director was not a party to the present petition.

not_decided_register.title: Navi Hasan v. U.P. Power Corporation & Another
not_decided_register.point: Correctness/quantum of the electricity dues underlying the demand (Rs. 5,19,525/-)
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; to be determined afresh by the assessing authority after due process.

not_decided_register.title: Northern Coalfield Ltd. v. Chairman and Managing Director, U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. & Ors.
not_decided_register.point: Whether a HV-2 consumer that is a continuous-process industry or on an independent feeder can opt out of restricted/peak-hours power supply altogether so as to avoid the 15% surcharge
not_decided_register.note: Expressly left open for decision in an appropriate future case.

not_decided_register.title: Om Prakash s/o Gauri Shankar v. Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. & Ors.
not_decided_register.point: Correctness/quantum of the recovery notice (Rs. 2,54,686/-)
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; the writ petition was withdrawn on the understanding the petitioner would approach the Supply Code authority instead.

not_decided_register.title: Om Prakash v. State of U.P. & Others
not_decided_register.point: Merits of the petitioner's electricity-bill grievance
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; left to the Clause 7.10 Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum/Ombudsman process.

not_decided_register.title: Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. v. Raman Ispat Private Limited & Ors.
not_decided_register.point: Effect of non-registration of PVVNL's charge under s.77, Companies Act, 2013 on its secured-creditor status
not_decided_register.note: Not ruled on — the Court declined to disturb the concurrent NCLT/NCLAT findings that PVVNL was a secured creditor, given later factual developments (liquidator's own application recognising PVVNL as a secured operational creditor).

not_decided_register.title: Pawan Kumar Laur v. State of U.P. & Others
not_decided_register.point: Merits of the theft allegation and compliance with Supply Code inspection procedure
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; left for trial/investigation.

not_decided_register.title: Prem Singh v. State of U.P. & 2 Others
not_decided_register.point: Correctness of the electricity bill assessment
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; relegated to the Clause 6.5 authority.

not_decided_register.title: Priy Shankar Pandey v. State of U.P. & 4 Others
not_decided_register.point: Whether the pole/line placement on the petitioner's land should proceed or be relocated
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; left to the Clause 3, Works of Licensees Rules 2006 authority after hearing all parties.

not_decided_register.title: Priya Prem v. Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Ltd. & 4 Others
not_decided_register.point: Merits of the new-connection application and s.43(3) penalty claim
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; left to the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum.

not_decided_register.title: Raju v. Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. & Another
not_decided_register.point: Whether the petitioner in fact used the electricity connection at an unauthorized premises
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; the Court expressly declined to go into the merits, leaving the department at liberty to issue a fresh show-cause notice.

not_decided_register.title: Sandeep Kesarwani v. State of U.P. & 3 Others
not_decided_register.point: Correctness/quantum of the theft-based electricity dues (Rs. 8,49,173/-)
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; to be determined afresh by the Executive Engineer after the petitioner's objections and a fresh hearing.

not_decided_register.title: Sanjay Rizvi v. M.D. Kanpur Electricity Supply Co. & Others
not_decided_register.point: Whether the petitioner in fact committed unauthorised use/theft of electricity, and the correct quantum of under-billed consumption
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; left to a fresh departmental determination after a reasoned hearing, with appeal rights preserved under s.127/Clause 6.8(d).

not_decided_register.title: Sanjay Rizvi v. M.D. Kanpur Electricity Supply Co. & Others
not_decided_register.point: Entitlement to refund of the Rs. 2,80,000/- compounding fee
not_decided_register.note: Not decided on the merits; the respondents contended the compounding fee is levied by and payable to the State Government, not refundable by the licensee.

not_decided_register.title: Satya Narayan v. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. thru. its Managing Director & Others
not_decided_register.point: Precise quantum refundable to the petitioner
not_decided_register.note: Not finally quantified; the licensee directed to compute and consider refund of any amount paid in excess of a proper two-year recovery, per the petitioner's representation.

not_decided_register.title: Shishir Jain v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. & Another
not_decided_register.point: Whether the premises was in fact being used commercially (LMV-2) or residentially (LMV-1), and the correct assessment amount
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; left to a proper final assessment after hearing.

not_decided_register.title: Shiv Shankar Giri v. Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. & Others
not_decided_register.point: Correctness/quantum of the theft-based assessment (Rs. 1,14,361 plus charges)
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; to be determined by the Executive Engineer after considering the petitioner's objections.

not_decided_register.title: Shivmahraj v. State of U.P. & 6 Others
not_decided_register.point: Whether the pole/line placement on the petitioner's land should proceed or be relocated
not_decided_register.note: Not decided; left to the Clause 3, Works of Licensees Rules 2006 authority (District Magistrate) after hearing all parties.

not_decided_register.title: Shri Kunwar Sarvesh Kumar Singh v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. & Ors.
not_decided_register.point: Effect of the petitioner's subsequent criminal acquittal on the theft-based civil assessment under Clause 8.2(X)(g)/(h)
not_decided_register.note: Remanded to the Commissioner (Appellate Authority) for independent determination, unencumbered by the High Court's observations on the assessment-procedure issues.

not_decided_register.title: Shyam Ferrous Ltd. Gopal Nagar v. State of U.P. & 6 Others
not_decided_register.point: Whether Clause 6.15's two-year bar (Section 56(2)-analogue) would apply differently to purely post-2003-Act peak-hour or other penalty liabilities
not_decided_register.note: Left open — the Court expressly declined to finally resolve the broader scope-of-Section-56(2) question raised regarding Paliwal Alloys, treating it as academic on the facts of this case (a pre-2003-Act liability).
